description: Replaces the program's price step with the rule printed in Szczepanczyk (2023), p. 7, read literally ("except when v > 0.25 then v = 0.25", so the cap applies to both occurrences): w = min(v, 0.25) * (1.05 - 0.5^min(v, 0.25)), with v this round's relative imbalance of the commodity, |2 * surplus| / (supply + demand). No lag and no floor. Line 718 binds price-delta-to-use and line 719 binds delta, the step; the new text computes both from this round's surplus, supply and demand. Every other line runs as committed. The formula is step_paper in research/upstream/_price_rules.py.
